issue.title: Mac CI Build: eventWarningBanner is missing a return after inline Markdown setup
issue.description: Observed while auditing bob-cli-fc.4. bob-mac-capture runs https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/41377358537 (6f13e48) and https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/41378013621 (1b196f4) both fail Build at Sources/BobMacCapture/CapturePanelView.swift:4688:18: function declares an opaque return type, but has no return statements. The bob-cli-f6 landing commit 6f13e48 added local displayHeadline setup to eventWarningBanner but left its final VStack without return or a result builder. fc.4 edits another method. Restore an explicit return or appropriate builder, compile the macOS targets, and verify the method; follow linked repo AGENTS.md. f6 is already closed, no active epic owns this defect; duplicate and recent-task sweeps found none.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both clean-base run 41377358537 and later run 41378013621 fail on the identical Swift opaque-return compile error; source has statements before an unreturned VStack.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-fc landing audit found a new pre-existing Calendar banner compiler failure on both its clean base and final Mac commit.
